# discord_channel_follower (List Resource)

Lists the channels of a server, or one channel, that follow an announcement channel. Requires the Manage Webhooks permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "discord_channel_follower" "all" {
  provider         = discord
  include_resource = true

  config {
    server_id = var.server_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild) to list channel followers of.

### Optional

- `channel_id` (String) Only list the channel followers of this channel.
